title: Hivestorm journeys
description: Players' experience of Hivestorm, as its README describes it to them.

entities.name: Climb the high-score table
entities.description: A player takes on the hive, enters a game on the table and comes back to see it.
entities.goal: Get a name onto the public table, higher than before.

stages.context: Arrives at the game signed out.
stages.action: Signs in, and is sent back to the game.
stages.outcome: The title screens, showing the points for each alien and the top ten in turn.

stages.context: Three ships, and an extra one at 7,000.
stages.touchpoint: The game's screen, with keys or the touch buttons
stages.action: Presses 1, shoots the hive and the divers, and takes on diving queens for their bonus, wave after wave.
stages.outcome: A score and the wave reached, when the last ship is lost.

stages.context: The score makes the top ten.
stages.touchpoint: The name form under the screen
stages.action: Types a name and presses ENTER.
stages.outcome: The table, with the new row flashing.
The top 25, each checked by replay, for anyone to see.

entities.name: Play a friend online
entities.description: Two friends, each on their own device, meet in the multiplayer lobby and play a two-player game, taking turns.
entities.goal: Play a friend who is somewhere else, score against score.

stages.context: Both are signed in to the games.
stages.action: One starts a Hivestorm game and waits; the other joins by typing that player's address.
stages.outcome: A countdown, cut short when everyone presses Ready.

stages.context: The game opens on both devices; whoever joined the lobby's game first is player 1.
stages.touchpoint: The game's screen, and the line under it
stages.action: Each plays their own turns and watches the other's; the turn passes when a ship is lost.
stages.outcome: The same game on both screens; a slow connection makes the other wait, and they are told. If one leaves, the other plays both turns.

stages.touchpoint: The game over screen and the name form
stages.action: Sees who won, and enters a name if their score makes the table.
stages.outcome: Each player's score on the table under their own name, sent once by the host's browser.

stages.touchpoint: BACK TO MULTIPLAYER, under the screen
stages.outcome: The lobby, ready for another game.

relatedViews.relationship: The use cases behind the journeys' stages.
